'''Oruba''' was an elder [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from the [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]] [[kajidic]] who served as a member of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tatooine! Tatooine!|Oruba's last words|<ref name="Eminence">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Oruba_Hologram.png|thumb|left|200px|Oruba voicing his concerns about Ziro.]]
At some point before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, Oruba was born on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. He created a [[Oruba's criminal empire|criminal empire]], and gained enough power in his [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]],<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> that he became the [[Kajidii/Legends|leader]] and represented it on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he discussed the plans to release [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody with other Hutt council members [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga]], [[Arok/Legends|Arok]] and [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]], as Ziro had potentially damaging [[Hutt Council records/Legends|information]] about Hutt activities.<ref name="EP" /> Deciding that it was safer for Ziro under the 'protection' of the Hutts, they hired [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to free Ziro on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="EP" /> which succeeded after a [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|hostage]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="SH">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>

Sometime later, Ziro appeared before the council.<ref name="HFZ">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> Oruba did not speak when Ziro addressed the council and reminded them that if anything where to happen to him the Hutt Council records would find their way into the hands of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Ziro was then imprisoned. Later, Oruba and the rest of the council where entertained by [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] who performed the musical number Da Hutt Moda.<ref name="HFZ" />

Jedi Knights [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] later appeared before the council and informed them of Ziro's escape.<ref name="HFZ" /> When Vos accused the Council of arranging Ziro's escape from the [[Republic Detention Center]], Oruba became angry with the Jedi Knight. The elder Hutt angrily glared at him while Obi-Wan reminded Vos that the Hutts were their allies.<ref name="HFZ" /> Meanwhile, Ziro broke free with the help of Sy Snootles, but his freedom was short-lived as he was killed on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="HFZ" />

[[File:OrubasDeath-Eminence.png|thumb|right|250px|Oruba moments before his death]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Oruba was present with Arok and Marlo, along with Gorga and Jabba who were seen in holograms.<ref name="Eminence" /> When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] came before the council to seek an alliance, the confrontation became a [[Mission to Nal Hutta/Legends|skirmish]].<ref name="Eminence" /> While Arok and Marlo were able to escape, Oruba was injured and eventually executed by Savage after the frightened Hutt gave the location of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="Shadow Conspiracy" />

==Personality and traits==
Oruba was identified by his relatively narrow head for a Hutt and the fact that he wore clothes. He also wore a kind of beret on his head.<ref name="EP" /> Oruba's pale skin was due to a genetic defect that left it without pigment and prone to chafe. He wore clothes to hide his condition.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Like most Hutts, Oruba was fond of musical entertainment.

==Behind the scenes==
Oruba is also seen in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 9|9th edition]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine]], by [[Titan Magazines]]. In it, he was identified as having quick wits and using self-preservation that helped his empire to grow. However, those traits did not help him when Maul arrived.
